verdicts.reason: A is broken: the can is separated from its cream circle, which is stranded half off-canvas in the bottom-left corner. The can body becomes an orange-on-orange outline, so the product almost disappears. The headline is small, and NEW floats alone at the top right. B keeps the can-in-circle graphic intact but jams it into the top-left corner. The text row and CTA crowd the right edge, the bottom ~40% of the canvas is dead space, and the can label text is illegible. Overall B still reads as a squashed banner, not a re-laid-out landscape design.
